class decorator.description:
TS 5.0 (standard decorators)
class decorator
A function invoked with the class itself and a `ClassDecoratorContext`; may return a replacement class. Applied as `@decoratorName class Foo {}`.

method decorator.description:
TS 5.0 (standard decorators)
method decorator
Wraps a class method; receives the original method and a `ClassMethodDecoratorContext`, and may return a replacement function.

field decorator.description:
TS 5.0 (standard decorators)
field decorator
Receives a `ClassFieldDecoratorContext` and may return an initializer function that transforms the field's initial value.

accessor auto-accessor field.description:
TS 5.0 (standard decorators)
accessor auto-accessor field
The `accessor` keyword turns a field into a private-backed getter/setter pair, making it a valid target for `ClassAccessorDecoratorContext`-based decorators.

decorator factory.description:
TS 5.0 (standard decorators)
decorator factory
A function that returns a decorator, letting the decorator itself take configuration arguments: `@decoratorName(option) class Foo {}`.
